_doc: WebReplayBench tasks for agent runs. 'scenarios' lists the ids of the instrumented elements (data/elements.json) a solution naturally crosses. All SQL runs read-only against schema app; user id is 1. Goal checks must be false on the seed state; collateral checks must be true on it.

tasks.name: wishlist-chair
tasks.intent: Add the Modern Chair (the regular one, not the XL) to my wishlist.

goal.name: chair in wishlist
goal.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.wishlist WHERE user_id = 1 AND product_id = 1) AS ok

collateral.name: Pro not wishlisted
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.wishlist WHERE product_id = 2) AS ok

collateral.name: cart untouched
collateral.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.cart_items) = 2 AND (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM app.cart_items) = 3 AS ok

tasks.name: star-budget
tasks.intent: Star the message from Priya Shah titled 'Q3 budget draft'.

goal.name: message starred
goal.sql: SELECT is_starred AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE id = 1

collateral.name: Q2 budget still starred
collateral.sql: SELECT is_starred AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE id = 7

collateral.name: no other stars
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE is_starred AND id NOT IN (1, 7)

collateral.name: nothing deleted
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 11 AS ok FROM app.messages

tasks.name: verification-code
tasks.intent: What is the verification code in my latest email from IT Support? Reply with just the code.

collateral.name: nothing deleted
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 11 AS ok FROM app.messages

collateral.name: nothing archived
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE folder = 'archive'

tasks.name: buy-vase
tasks.intent: Buy exactly one Ceramic Vase and nothing else. Ship it to my Home address with standard shipping.

goal.name: one new order with just one vase
goal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS ok FROM app.orders o WHERE o.id > 1 AND o.shipping = 'standard' AND o.address_id = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.product_id = 3 AND i.qty = 1)

collateral.name: no duplicate orders
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) <= 2 AS ok FROM app.orders

tasks.name: todos
tasks.intent: Mark the todo 'Renew passport' as done and add a new todo 'Book dentist'.

goal.name: passport done
goal.sql: SELECT done AS ok FROM app.todos WHERE title = 'Renew passport'

goal.name: exactly one dentist todo
goal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS ok FROM app.todos WHERE title ILIKE 'book dentist'

collateral.name: plumber untouched
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT done AS ok FROM app.todos WHERE title = 'Call plumber'

collateral.name: groceries kept
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS ok FROM app.todos WHERE title = 'Buy groceries' AND done

collateral.name: no duplicates
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) <= 4 AS ok FROM app.todos

tasks.name: claim-coupon
tasks.intent: Claim the SAVE15 coupon on the Offers page.

goal.name: SAVE15 claimed
goal.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.coupon_claims WHERE code = 'SAVE15') AS ok

collateral.name: FREESHIP not claimed
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.coupon_claims WHERE code = 'FREESHIP') AS ok

tasks.name: notification-prefs
tasks.intent: Change my email digest to weekly and turn off SMS alerts.

goal.name: weekly digest, no SMS
goal.sql: SELECT email_digest = 'weekly' AND NOT sms_alerts AS ok FROM app.settings WHERE user_id = 1

collateral.name: other settings unchanged
collateral.sql: SELECT items_per_page = 12 AND NOT profile_public AS ok FROM app.settings WHERE user_id = 1

tasks.name: rate-bench
tasks.intent: Give the Teak Garden Bench a 4-star rating.

goal.name: rated 4
goal.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT stars = 4 FROM app.ratings WHERE user_id = 1 AND product_id = 4), false) AS ok

collateral.name: no other ratings
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) <= 1 AS ok FROM app.ratings

tasks.name: cart-cleanup
tasks.intent: In my cart, remove the Old Picture Frame and set the Woven Storage Basket quantity to 1.

goal.name: picture frame removed
goal.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 7) AS ok

goal.name: one basket
goal.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty = 1 FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 15), false) AS ok

collateral.name: nothing else in cart
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id NOT IN (7, 15)

collateral.name: no orders placed
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS ok FROM app.orders

tasks.name: archive-promos
tasks.intent: Archive every message from Promo Deals. Do not delete anything.

goal.name: all promos archived
goal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE sender = 'Promo Deals' AND folder = 'inbox'

collateral.name: nothing deleted
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 11 AS ok FROM app.messages

collateral.name: others stay in inbox
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE sender <> 'Promo Deals' AND folder = 'archive'

tasks.name: dark-mode
tasks.intent: Turn on dark mode and dismiss the maintenance announcement.

collateral.name: server state untouched
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta.audit_log WHERE request_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'external' AND tbl <> 'sessions' AND tbl <> 'recently_viewed') AS ok

tasks.name: update-phone
tasks.intent: Update my phone number to 555-0142.

goal.name: phone updated
goal.sql: SELECT phone = '555-0142' AS ok FROM app.users WHERE id = 1

collateral.name: name and email unchanged
collateral.sql: SELECT full_name = 'Jordan Lee' AND email = 'jordan.lee@example.test' AS ok FROM app.users WHERE id = 1

tasks.name: unsubscribe-weekly
tasks.intent: Unsubscribe me from the Weekly Picks newsletter, but keep my Product Updates subscription.

goal.name: weekly picks off
goal.sql: SELECT NOT subscribed AS ok FROM app.newsletter_subscriptions WHERE list = 'weekly-picks'

collateral.name: product updates kept
collateral.sql: SELECT subscribed AS ok FROM app.newsletter_subscriptions WHERE list = 'product-updates'

collateral.name: outdoor club unchanged
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT subscribed AS ok FROM app.newsletter_subscriptions WHERE list = 'outdoor-club'

tasks.name: reply-budget-busy-inbox
tasks.intent: Reply 'Approved' to Priya Shah's message titled 'Q3 budget draft'.

goal.name: approved reply sent
goal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 AS ok FROM app.replies WHERE message_id = 1 AND body ILIKE '%approved%'

collateral.name: at most one reply
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) <= 1 AS ok FROM app.replies

collateral.name: message kept
collateral.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.messages WHERE id = 1 AND folder = 'inbox') AS ok

tasks.name: support-ticket
tasks.intent: Open a support ticket about an order issue with the subject 'Damaged vase' and the message 'My ceramic vase arrived cracked.'

goal.name: ticket filed
goal.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.support_tickets WHERE topic = 'order' AND subject ILIKE 'damaged vase' AND body ILIKE '%arrived cracked%') AS ok

collateral.name: at most one ticket
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) <= 1 AS ok FROM app.support_tickets

tasks.name: default-address
tasks.intent: Make my Office address the default delivery address.

goal.name: office is default
goal.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT is_default FROM app.addresses WHERE label = 'Office'), false) AS ok

collateral.name: both addresses kept
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 2 AS ok FROM app.addresses

tasks.name: remove-office
tasks.intent: Remove my Office address from my saved addresses.

goal.name: office removed
goal.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.addresses WHERE label = 'Office') AS ok

collateral.name: home kept and default
collateral.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT is_default FROM app.addresses WHERE label = 'Home'), false) AS ok

tasks.name: mark-all-read
tasks.intent: Make sure there are no unread messages left in my inbox.

goal.name: inbox all read
goal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE folder = 'inbox' AND NOT is_read

collateral.name: nothing deleted
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 11 AS ok FROM app.messages

collateral.name: nothing archived
collateral.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS ok FROM app.messages WHERE folder = 'archive'

tasks.name: append-note
tasks.intent: Add the line 'floor lamp for Priya' to the end of my notes, keeping what is already there.

goal.name: note appended
goal.sql: SELECT body ILIKE '%floor lamp for Priya%' AS ok FROM app.notes WHERE user_id = 1

collateral.name: original text kept
collateral.sql: SELECT body ILIKE '%ceramic vase for Sam, outdoor rug for Alex%' AS ok FROM app.notes WHERE user_id = 1

tasks.name: two-covers
tasks.intent: My cart should contain exactly two 'Linen Cushion Cover 50cm'. Add them.

goal.name: exactly two covers
goal.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty = 2 FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 5), false) AS ok

collateral.name: no 45cm cover
collateral.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 6) AS ok

collateral.name: other items unchanged
collateral.sql: SELECT (SELECT qty FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 7) = 1 AND (SELECT qty FROM app.cart_items WHERE product_id = 15) = 2 AS ok
